name: year
description: Reference year of the quarter-end observation

name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4
observations: APRA labels each quarter by its final month: Q1 March, Q2 June, Q3 September, Q4 December

name: institution_type
description: Authorised deposit-taking institution type or grouping

name: measure
description: Coded measure within the statement (see dictionary for the label)

name: unit
description: Unit of the value: aud_million, proportion or unit

name: value
description: Reported value of the measure (unit given by the unit column; NULL when not applicable or confidentiality-masked)
